headline: Connect TwinCAT devices through ADS
intro: The ADS integration connects Home Assistant with Beckhoff automation devices running TwinCAT through the device-independent, fieldbus-independent ADS interface. Configure the device AMS NetId and AMS server port, then map ADS variables to entities for binary sensors, lights, sensors, switches, covers, selects, and valves.
highlights: Connect using the device AMS NetId and AMS server port
Read numeric ADS variables as sensors, with supported data types from BOOL through LREAL
Control supported lights, covers, switches, selects, and valves through configured ADS variables

flow.title: From ADS connection to Home Assistant entities
stages: Set the ADS device NetId and AMS server port in configuration.yaml
Add entity platforms and identify the ADS variables they use
Restart Home Assistant to load the configuration
